response.explanation: At line 22, src/presentation/server.ts imports `TextHiveClient` straight from the persistence layer (`../persistence/textHiveClient`). Lines 12-21 do the same with the repository classes from `../persistence/repositories`. The same file already gets its business behaviour through the business layer: it imports HiveService, ScaleService, TreatmentService, ReportService and the business errors (lines 2-11), and createServer takes those services as parameters (lines 56-60). FF-S03 flags the import because presentation reaches past the business layer to a concrete persistence class, so the HTTP layer now depends on how storage is implemented. The visible excerpt ends at line 60, so it doesn't show how TextHiveClient is used. It may only be wiring (composition-root style), or the handlers may call it directly. Either way, the dependency points down past an intermediate layer, which this rule forbids. No document, ADR or comment was provided that says this is intended.
